summary: Silvercorp Metals Inc. filed a Form 6-K with an attached technical report on the Curipamba-El Domo Polymetallic Project in Ecuador, prepared by SRK Consulting China Ltd. The filing is a routine disclosure of mineral resource and reserve estimates, feasibility studies, and cost analysis under SEC rules for foreign issuers. No transaction, corporate action, or special situation is involved. There are no deal terms, price per share, premium, or board recommendations. This is a standard technical report update with no M&A, activist, or restructuring implications. What to watch: no event-driven catalyst.
